steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three effective strategies for cutting urban carbon emissions:

1. Electrify and Expand Public Transit  
   • Transition bus and rail fleets to electric or hydrogen power.  
   • Increase service frequency and coverage to make transit more convenient than driving.  
   • Offer integrated ticketing and real-time apps to boost ridership.

2. Invest in Active-Transport Infrastructure  
   • Build protected bike lanes, wider sidewalks, and pedestrian-only zones.  
   • Implement bike-share and e-scooter programs with safe parking.  
   • Calm traffic in neighborhoods (e.g., lower speed limits, woonerfs) to encourage walking.

3. Retrofit Buildings for Energy Efficiency  
   • Insulate walls and roofs; install double- or triple-glazed windows.  
   • Upgrade heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems to high-efficiency or heat-pump units.  
   • Mandate or incentivize green-roof installations and on-site solar panels.
